paragraphs.text: The Thalakos Lowlands were the part of Rath where the shadowy Thalakos lived.

The Thalakos Lowlands were wide open plains covered with pale grasses, cut through with silent waterways. The Thalakos themselves were trapped in the Shadow realm and were not fully physically present, although some were able to touch and affect the solid world of Rath .
During the Rathi Overlay , the Thalakos Lowlands were shifted to Dominaria , but it is not known where they ended up or if they were destroyed in the process.
